messages:
erin.leung: Quick post-incident note — detection triggered on anomalous S3 access pattern at 03:12 UTC, rotated exposed creds and blocked the service principal. Opening this thread for action items and detection tuning.
jamal.cho: Thanks Erin. Can you drop the detection rule id and timeline here? want to triage root cause vs noisy signal.
sec-bot: Alert: DET-2026-4987 triggered (anomalous_s3_get_object_count). Events: 42 in 5m. Severity: medium.
erin.leung: Rule id DET-2026-4987. Timeline: first suspicious call 03:08, lateral requests detected 03:11, blocked by revocation 03:14.
li.wu: Quick log query I ran to validate — pasted for posterity:
```
# CloudTrail query (Athena)
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.type, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.bucketName
FROM cloudtrail_logs
WHERE eventName = 'GetObject'
AND sourceIPAddress NOT IN ('10.0.0.0/8','192.168.0.0/16')
AND eventTime BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2026-03-18 03:00:00' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-03-18 03:20:00'
ORDER BY eventTime;
```
li.wu: Found the sequence — a service principal used an older role that had overly broad S3 access.
sofia.mendez: Looks like RBAC drift again. The role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/service-data-replication had s3:* on prod buckets. We should limit to s3:GetObject and explicit prefixes.
alex.kim: +1. Also noticed CloudTrail wasn't logging KMS Decrypt events consistently for that key — need to confirm KMS key policy and key rotation status.
erin.leung: Action list I propose (owners & due):
- tighten role policy for service-data-replication to least privilege (owner: sofia.mendez, due: 2026-03-22)
- add audit alert for KMSDecrypt spikes (owner: alex.kim, due: 2026-03-23)
- add synthetic access test and detection regression suite (owner: jamal.cho, due: 2026-03-25)
- update incident runbook section on credential exposure (owner: rachel.k, due: 2026-03-24)
- add a weekly RBAC drift report to infra dashboard (owner: li.wu, due: 2026-03-29)

sofia.mendez: For the RBAC change, here's the diff I want to apply. Keeping it small to avoid deploy friction:
```
- "Action": "s3:*",
+ "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:ListBucket"],
  "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-prod-logs/*", "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-prod-logs"]
```
sofia.mendez: I'll open a PR in infra-iam and tag @eng-oncall for a quick review.
jamal.cho: For detection tuning — current rule thresholds were too low for our nightly batch. I suggest adding an allowlist for the replications account ids and a short sliding-window anomaly score.
li.wu: Also adding query coverage: make sure CloudTrail and Config both capture changes to key policies and role inline policies. I found a 12-hour gap in KMS Decrypt audit ingestion last week.
alex.kim: KMS notes: key rotation is enabled but the key policy allowed kms:Decrypt to several service principals. I'll propose a scoped key policy and test decryption from the replication job.
sec-bot: New issue created: SECURITY-744 — "Post-incident: RBAC tightening + KMS audit" assigned to sofia.mendez.
rachel.k: I'll draft a short comms blurb for affected teams and schedule a 30m tabletop to walk the path and ensure visibility. Propose 2026-03-26 16:00 UTC.
erin.leung: Good — please add the tabletop agenda: timeline, threat vector, detection gaps, RBAC remediation, KMS policy changes, verification steps, and follow-up owners.
jamal.cho: I'll prepare a short demo for the detection regression (fake traffic generator + CloudTrail assertions).
sofia.mendez: Tagging @eng-qa for pre-deploy validation on RBAC PR.
alex.kim: Also want a KMS decryption audit query to be added to the weekly security dashboard. Proposed Athena snippet:
```
SELECT eventTime, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId, count(*) AS decrypts
FROM cloudtrail_logs
WHERE eventName = 'Decrypt'
AND eventTime > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14' DAY
GROUP BY eventTime, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId
ORDER BY decrypts DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
li.wu: One more follow-up: add an automated playbook step to rotate any creds observed in public gist or code host repos. We should integrate a webhook from code scanning to incident ticket creation.
erin.leung: Summarizing: owners assigned, PRs and security-744 created, tabletop scheduled. If no objections I'll move these into the post-incident board and mark the immediate containment as closed.
rachel.k: No objections from my side. I'll own the tabletop invite and comms.
sofia.mendez: Starting the RBAC PR now.
jamal.cho: I'll start the synthetic traffic tests today.
erin.leung: Great work team. Add any other notes here. :white_check_mark:
